item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Investigation of the biological and environmental bases of the risk for major psychiatric disorders, including mood disorders and psychosis, and of the biological pathways related to this. (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-28 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Roma
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-11 Psichiatria

The research program aims to investigate the biological and environmental determinants of risk for major psychiatric disorders and the molecular pathways through which such risk translates into clinical phenotype. The approach will integrate genetic information, neuroimaging measures, environmental factors and clinical assessment, in order to characterize the mechanisms linking individual variability, brain circuit organization and symptom expression. Computational tools will then be developed on these data to stratify patients into biologically homogeneous subgroups and to identify molecular correlates informing treatment selection. Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-08 Endocrinologia, nefrologia e scienze dell'alimentazione e del benessere

Rare endocrine-metabolic diseases represent a heterogeneous group of disorders, predominantly of genetic origin, characterized by alterations in endocrine function and/or metabolism, constituting a major healthcare challenge. Their high clinical complexity, phenotypic variability, and frequent multisystemic presentation often make timely recognition difficult, leading to diagnostic and therapeutic delays. The project aims to contribute to the early identification of suggestive signs and symptoms, to the diagnostic framework through an integrated clinical, biochemical, and genetic approach, and to the definition of therapeutic strategies, while organizing long-term follow-up for patients.…
